response.original_title: Pacific Opera Project The Magic Flute AKA "SUPERFLUTE"
response.overview: A modern and unique interpretation of Mozarts Opera Die Zauberflöte (The Magic Flute) performed by the Pacific Opera Project performed on 3/25/2023 and archived to Youtube. Two young boys play video games past their bedtime against their mothers orders, mysteriously mashing up their two favorite games and retelling the Operas plot through various videogame characters.
